title: selliguea proteus
intro: Selliguea proteus, commonly known as the Selaginella, is a type of plant that belongs to the Selaginellaceae family. It is a small, evergreen, and perennial plant native to the tropical regions of Asia and the Pacific. The health benefits of Selliguea proteus include its potential to lower blood sugar levels, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
